patch: head-window.patch (applied by build.sh to the pinned sha; env LLAMA_HEAD_WINDOW='il:kv_head,...', LLAMA_HEAD_WINDOW_W, LLAMA_HEAD_WINDOW_SINKS; unset = graph unchanged)
shape_note: GGUF metadata (llama-tokenize -v, vocab only): qwen35.block_count 32, full_attention_interval 4 (llama.cpp: layer il is full attention iff (il+1) % 4 == 0 -> 3,7,...,31), attention.head_count 16, head_count_kv 4, key_length 256, n_vocab 248320, no BOS added. Head index i = 4 * (rank of its layer in full_layers) + kv_head; query heads 4*g..4*g+3 read KV head g.
calib_rule: calibration docs = runs 2-4's calibration articles 12/16/18 of wiki.valid.raw (run 1's article split), each required to have >= ctx + margin tokens in the 9B's tokenizer (llama-tokenize on the GGUF vocab)
fresh_rule: the first n_fresh articles of wiki.valid.raw in file order (run 1's article split) with >= ctx + margin tokens in the 9B's tokenizer, excluding every doc id runs 1-4 used (read by program from prior_cells params.json: eval_docs, calib_docs, exclude_docs, run 4's fresh_docs) and calib_ids; picked by osc_l4_9b.py --pick (tokenizer only) and fixed here BEFORE any model pass
doc_rule: each doc file = the article body repeated past 2*ctx tokens (llama-perplexity refuses < 2*ctx); --chunks 1 evaluates only the first ctx tokens, which lie inside the first copy (>= margin tokens before the junction); KL and same-top are over the 1023 scored positions ctx/2 .. ctx-2 (llama-perplexity's second half)
direct_def: per KV head h: h alone windowed (4 sinks + last 128 keys, its 4 query heads), llama-perplexity --kl-divergence vs the UNPATCHED build's base logits (flash-attn off, -c 2048 -b 2048 --chunks 1, 6 threads), Mean KLD per calibration doc, averaged over the 3 calibration docs; ascending, ties by index. Written to ranking.json by --rank and copied into params.json frozen_direct_ranking by --freeze BEFORE scoring
random_def: per k: random_sets[k][s] = sorted(random.Random(seed).sample(range(32), k)) for each seed, written by --freeze
zero_rule: the patched build with NO heads listed on calibration doc 0: (a) its Mean KLD vs the unpatched base <= zero_tol and (b) the base logits file it writes is byte-identical (sha256) to the unpatched one
rule: void if a fresh doc is among the excluded ids (or repeats), frozen_direct_ranking differs from ranking.json or from the ranking re-read from the calibration logs, or the zero-mask check fails; else proved iff DIRECT's pooled KL (mean over fresh docs) < the minimum pooled KL of the 5 random sets at BOTH k = 8 and k = 16; else disproved. Reported: same-top (llama-perplexity 'Same top p') per arm; per-doc wins; context 8192 only if the wall allows (needs docs >= 8192 + margin tokens)
pick_note: calib_docs / fresh_docs as [id, title, tokens in the 9B tokenizer], from osc_l4_9b.py --pick (llama-tokenize, GGUF vocab only, no weights) at 2026-10-01, fixed and committed BEFORE any model pass; excluded_docs = the exclusion set that pick read by program (runs 1-4 + calib_ids)
